text:
sasha: quick heads-up — i'm going to spin up model-rev4-quant2 in staging canary at 10% traffic in 5m. proposal for rollout gating:

sasha: requirements:
- global quality delta (eval accuracy) <= 1.5% vs prod baseline
- no safety-slice drop > 2% on any mandated slice
- p99 latency <= +12% vs baseline
- if any of the above fails for 10 continuous mins -> automatic fallback

liam: can we make the quality check a binary composite instead of raw delta? e.g. pass if all critical slices pass AND overall delta < 1.5%

maria: +1 to slice-wise pass. also suggest adding a small hallucination check on the long-doc slice (we saw rev3 weirdness there). maybe a fuzzy match threshold on gold answers

aj: for the p99 condition: prefer looking at weighted p99 (weight by traffic slice) so tiny noisy slices don't kill the whole canary. fallback only if weighted p99 exceeds threshold for 3 intervals (3 x 120s)

liam: ok that makes sense. for automatic fallback window — i'd prefer 5 minutes of sustained breach rather than immediate 10min continuous window. keeps canaries responsive

sasha: agree on weighted p99. compromise: staged fallback rules:
- transient breach (<5m) -> alert + hold (no ramp)
- sustained breach (>=5m) -> auto-fallback
- catastrophic breach (safety slice fail) -> immediate rollback

maria: do we have metrics plumbing to compute 'safety slice fail' live? i know eval infra has it but need production slice telemetry in staging path

sasha: deploy-bot: can you confirm the canary will emit per-slice pass/fail metrics and weighted-p99 in the /metrics/canary namespace?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary start at 1718765480. metrics endpoint: /metrics/canary/model-rev4-quant2. will emit: canary.slice.<slice_name>.pass (0/1), canary.weighted_p99_ms, canary.overall_delta_pct

aj: perfect. i'll add the rollback action to the rollout-policy config and a slack alert to #eng-oncall if auto-fallback triggers

liam: one last ask — add a small quiet-burn shadow for 24h to capture any latent regressions before full promote. no traffic shift but collect diffs

sasha: done. i'll kick it off in 5. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — i'll watch the hallucination slice and post any oddities here

aj: logging the rollout-policy (snippet):
```yaml
rollout:
  target: 10%
  metrics:
    - name: canary.overall_delta_pct
      threshold: 1.5
      comparator: less_or_equal
    - name: canary.weighted_p99_ms
      threshold: +12%
      comparator: less_or_equal
    - name: canary.slice.hallucination_longdoc.pass
      comparator: equals
      value: 1
  fallback:
    transient_threshold_seconds: 300
    sustained_threshold_seconds: 300
    catastrophic_safety_immediate: true
```

sasha: filing a brief post-canary note after first 30m sample. if anything looks off we stop and revert.
